preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 200000 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
For each test case, k is exactly 2.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= y <= 20000000 for y in queries)
preconditions.description: Any query y printed must be an integer between 0 and 2*10^7 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(queries_for_case) <= n for queries_for_case, n in zip(all_queries, test_case_ns))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of queries made does not exceed n.

postconditions.expression: all(any(r == 1 for r in responses_for_case) for responses_for_case in all_responses)
postconditions.description: For each test case, at least one query results in r=1 (success).

postconditions.expression: all(all(r != -1 for r in responses_for_case) for responses_for_case in all_responses)
postconditions.description: No query results in r=-1 (invalid query or limit exceeded).

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= y <= 20000000 for y in queries) for queries in all_queries)
postconditions.description: All queries y are within the valid range [0, 2*10^7].
